title: Pentagon Tells Congress US Cost of Iran War Has Risen to $47.1 Billion
detail: The Pentagon reportedly told Congress the US military cost of the Iran war has risen to $47.1 billion. Reported via aggregator headline; figure not independently confirmed.

title: WSJ: US Warns Gulf States of Possible Short, Intense Renewal of Iran War After Midterms
detail: The Wall Street Journal reportedly says the US has warned Gulf states of a possible short, intense renewal of the war with Iran after the midterm elections. Reported via aggregator; not independently confirmed.

title: Qatari Mediators Present Iran With Deal to End the War, Official Says
detail: Qatari mediators have presented Iran with a proposed deal to end the war, according to an official cited in an aggregated headline. Terms and Iran's response not yet reported; not independently confirmed.

title: Report: US Has Not Warned Gulf Nations to Prepare for Possible Iran Offensive
detail: A headline reported via news aggregator says the US has not warned Gulf nations to prepare for a possible offensive against Iran. This appears to conflict with an earlier WSJ-attributed report of such warnings; neither is independently confirmed and the originating outlet is not identified in the feed.
